Config.Title: Sargas Dice Styles
Config.HintGM: Turn each dice style on or off for this world, and choose the style used for your own rolls. Players can only pick styles that are turned on.
Config.HintPlayer: Choose the style used for your dice. Everyone at the table sees your rolls in this style.
Config.NoneEnabled: Every style is turned off, so 3D dice are not shown.

styleConfig.Name: Dice styles
styleConfig.Label: Choose dice styles
styleConfig.Hint: Pick your dice style. GMs also turn styles on or off for the world.

enabled.Name: Show 3D dice
enabled.Hint: Animate dice on screen when rolls are made.

quality.Name: Render quality
quality.Hint: Lower quality uses smaller textures and no shadows. Takes effect after reloading.

speed.Name: Animation speed
speed.Hint: Playback speed of the dice animation.

fadeDelay.Name: Time on table (seconds)
fadeDelay.Hint: How long dice stay visible after they stop, before fading out.

volume.Name: Dice sound volume
volume.Hint: Volume of the dice collision sounds. Set to 0 to use Foundry's default roll sound instead.

showOthers.Name: Show other players' rolls
showOthers.Hint: Animate dice for rolls made by other users.

holdChat.Name: Hold chat until dice stop
holdChat.Hint: Hide a roll's chat card until its dice have finished rolling.

diceScale.Name: Dice size
diceScale.Hint: Size of the dice on screen for everyone in this world.

maxDice.Name: Maximum dice per roll
maxDice.Hint: Rolls with more dice than this only animate the first ones.

hiddenRolls.Name: Rolls you cannot see
hiddenRolls.Hint: What to show for blind or private rolls whose result is hidden from you.

HiddenRolls.ghost: Show dice without the real result

Notify.Fallback: Your chosen dice style was turned off by the GM. Your dice now use {style}.
Notify.DiceSoNice: Sargas Dice Set and Dice So Nice are both active, so each roll will animate twice. Disable one of them.
